name: The Adventurer
summary: On Zephras Isle, The Adventurer leaves Thendal Grove for the road to Shen'dar Village. Aetheen of the Gales sends newly seasoned wanderers southwest to meet Raan Wildwind, a veteran camper who knows the wilds.

sections.title: Leaving the Grove
sections.body: Thendal Grove offers shelter, but Zephras Isle beyond it remains wild and perilous. Aetheen of the Gales watches over the initiates and knows when a traveler is ready to leave familiar ground. Those seeking fame, fortune or purpose have outgrown the grove's sheltered bounds.

sections.title: A Guide on the Road
sections.body: Raan Wildwind has made camp southwest of Thendal Grove, along the road to Shen'dar Village. He has spent time facing the dangers beyond the safe haven. For wanderers setting out from the grove, Raan offers practical counsel on surviving the open roads.

faq.q: Who sends you to find Raan Wildwind?
faq.answer: Aetheen of the Gales sends you from Thendal Grove to find Raan Wildwind. After you prove yourself in the surrounding woods, she points you toward someone who knows the wider isle firsthand.
Raan Wildwind has made camp southwest of Thendal Grove, along the main road to Shen'dar Village.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this task?
faq.answer: You leave Thendal Grove's safe haven and meet a guide to the challenges farther across Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before receiving this quest?
faq.answer: Before Aetheen of the Gales sends you to Raan Wildwind, you must complete the task concerning the Foul Matriarch.

faq.q: Is Shen'dar Village safe for travelers?
faq.answer: Shen'dar Village lies beyond Raan's camp, at the end of the road southwest from Thendal Grove. It is a notable settlement, but take care on the roads and in the surrounding wilds.
Raan Wildwind is a wanderer who traveled beyond Thendal Grove and made camp outside Shen'dar Village. He offers practical advice and tasks to newcomers heading down the road.

angles.text: As a young Skyborne leaving Thendal Grove's sheltered canopy, you meet Raan Wildwind as your first step into the wider wilds of your island home.
